t:
I can’t believe how many more Jama’ah I’m catching because of Bilal

I missed asr at my local mosque and I found another mosque 2 mins away that was starting in 5 mins

Bilal literally helping me discover new mosques I never would have found before

I got you

Bilal now plays the athan in the background of whatever you’re watching on tv

(Had to find a star plus video to play for this demo lol)

So your mum watching Indian dramas won’t stop you from hearing the athan to leave
Bilal perfectly synced to a local mosque in Canada!

Maghrib was an interesting design challenge when building bilal

If I leave 15 mins way but Maghrib starts 5 mins before then I can’t play the athan 15 mins before

Bilal instead plays a ping notifying you to leave now and plays the athan at the start time

I missed asr at my local mosque

so I opened up bilal and hit refresh and it immediately found me the next closest mosque to me with a later jama’ah time that I can catch

So I caught it, I never knew this mosque even existed before bilal

Never miss a Jama’ah again

bilal has one simple goal:

to increase mosque jama'ah attendance

jummah shows you the potential of how full our mosques can be

we just need the call to prayer :)

day 6 of bilal testing:

I've finally manage to get multiple devices to sync to play the athan together!

how cool is that!

bilal is specifically timed to play to count for travel time to the mosque

so zuhr is at 1:30pm and im 15 mins away so it played the athan at 1:15

i think the best way to describe bilal is like a digital minaret

a fixed call from one location that is designed intentionally to interrupt you and call you to prayer at that moment in time

its not "prayer notification"

it's what adhan is supposed to be - a call to prayer

bilal will launch with over 1000+ mosques across 45+ countries

and will be available on the following devices:

- amazon echo shows
- amazon fire tvs
- google/android tv

Yeah this is the best form factor

Day 2 of testing and I’m hearing the athan loudly across the room according to jamaah times every salah

Early days but I’m already seeing the change in behaviour I anticipated!
bilal is so back.
bilal is nearly ready to ship aiming to to it this evening if possible watch this space!

Bilal working on smart speakers too!

(yes I need to optimise the design for smaller screens)

bilal’s sky subtly changes according to the time

I always wanted a beautiful prayer times display

did we cook?

This was the thesis for bilal nearly 2 years ago

Still relevant today

What if you turned your home tv into an always on digital display that played adhaan according to the Jama’ah time of the local masjid?

Just picking back up an old project I shelved before

Bilal is back!

Last night I saw the future of the UK Muslim startup scene.

As part of team Deen Developers and a batch member in their buildathon, I’m proud to witness and contribute to what we’re building. We’re at such an exciting time in the UK Muslim tech scene, and it’s incredible to watch this community grow from infancy. Seeing founders with both talent and integrity working to make a difference is what makes this movement truly unique.

Yes, there’s talk about how far behind we are compared to places like SF, but today showed just how optimistic we can be about bridging that gap. One of the founders did the opening recitation, setting the tone. We saw projects ranging from Quran and seerah apps to sadaqah platforms—all built with a deep grounding in faith.

And by the way, I’m working on something special too, a project called Bilal—but that’s a story for another post.

I’m grateful to be part of this moment and to support as many Muslim startups as possible. Let’s keep building, keep growing, and keep giving back, insha’Allah.

Shout out to the incredible team at DD Ibrahim Javed Muntasir Syed Taz Latif Ibraheem R. just to name a few!

Shout out to our roasters who came to support as always as they have since the beginning Shahzad Younas Ibrahim Khan Humayra Hanif

And shout out to the batch members, that we’ve seen grow and develop throughout the programme Kaazim Zia Sadiq Dorasat Hamada Mahdi Dilwoar Hussain

There’s so many more deserving of shoutouts apologies for missing people, they know who they are.

Everyone really came together to make this possible.

The future is bright inshaAllah.

why i'm building bilal

jummah and ramadan used to develop people more and create strong masjid centric communities

it's part of the wider vision of why we're building bilal

let's try to just get more people into our mosques regularly, the rest can start flourishing on its own

to build project bilal we’ve been pivoting for months to figure out the best way to build a Jama’ah habit

it wasn’t just to build any solution that plays the athan but how do we do that that genuinely builds into a lifelong habit?

can’t wait to start testing this publicly

this path is already not widely accessible and known, so how do we activate the rest of the Jummah congregation that want to build that habit?

we needed to build bilal to remind you, even if you forget

we need the athan to play 5x a day uninterrupted

FAQ: why isn't bilal a smartphone app?

when I looked at this from a product hat, it was clear that in order to build more for the undeserved it meant building more passive solutions than active solutions

what does that mean in context of Jama'ah times? 👇

the truth is, they don't

the reason they don't is when you hear the athan on your phone, it doesn't prompt you to do anything because you hear the prayer's start time not the time when Jama'ah happens
